text_en: Wisdom has built her house, she has hewn her seven pillars.
text_cn: 智慧建造了房舍，雕琢了七根石柱，

text_en: She has slaughtered her animals, she has mixed her wine, she has also set her table.
text_cn: 宰杀了牲畜，配制了美酒，铺设了饭桌，

text_en: She has sent out her servant-girls, she calls from the highest places in the town,
text_cn: 派出自己的使女，在城市高处呐喊：

text_en: “You that are simple, turn in here! ” To those without sense she says,
text_cn: “谁是无知的，请转身到这里来！”她对愚钝的人说：

text_en: “Come, eat of my bread and drink of the wine I have mixed.
text_cn: “你们来，吃我的食粮，饮我配制的酒！

text_en: Lay aside immaturity, and live, and walk in the way of insight. ”
text_cn: 你们应放弃无知，好使你们得以生存，并在明智的道路上迈进。”

text_en: Whoever corrects a scoffer wins abuse; whoever rebukes the wicked gets hurt.
text_cn: 谁矫正轻狂的人，只有自招羞辱；谁责斥邪恶的人，只有自找凌辱。

text_en: A scoffer who is rebuked will only hate you; the wise, when rebuked, will love you.
text_cn: 你不要责斥轻狂的人，免得他恨你；却要责斥明智的人，他必会爱你。

text_en: Give instruction to the wise, and they will become wiser still; teach the righteous and they will gain in learning.
text_cn: 你若指教明智的人，他必更明智；你若教训正义的人，他必更有见识。

text_en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom, and the knowledge of the Holy One is insight.
text_cn: 敬畏上主是智慧的肇基；认识至圣者就是睿智。

text_en: For by me your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.
text_cn: 藉着我，你的岁月才可增多，你的寿命才可延长。

text_en: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; if you scoff, you alone will bear it.
text_cn: 你若有智慧，你必蒙受其惠；你若是轻狂也只有自食其果。

text_en: The foolish woman is loud; she is ignorant and knows nothing.
text_cn: 愚昧太太， 浮燥愚蠢，一无所知。

text_en: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the high places of the town,
text_cn: 她坐在自家门前，坐在城内高处的座位上，

text_en: calling to those who pass by, who are going straight on their way,
text_cn: 向一往直前的路人喊说：

text_en: “You who are simple, turn in here! ” And to those without sense she says,
text_cn: “谁是无知的，请转身到这里来！”她向愚钝的人说：

text_en: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is pleasant. ”
text_cn: “偷来的水，更香甜；背地吃的饼，更有味。”

text_en: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.
text_cn: 他却不知冥域正在那里，她的客人都在阴府的深处。
